name: alegomes
description: Three-plugin multi-agent setup for Claude Code: shared mindset skills (common), full 9-agent topology (multi-team), and a lightweight 2-agent pair (solo-pair). Adapted from indydev Dan's lead-agents pattern.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Shared mindset skills required by the topology plugins (mental-model, active-listener, zero-micromanagement, conversational-response, till-done).

plugins.name: multi-team
plugins.description: Multi-team agent topology — orchestrator + 3 leads + 6 workers, with path-lock hook. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: solo-pair
plugins.description: Lightweight 2-agent topology — one dev, one reviewer, no leads. For small tweaks where multi-team orchestration overhead isn't worth it. Requires common@alegomes.
